skill.displayName: Free AI Clothes Changer – Change Clothes in Photos with Virtual Try-On AI Technology – CLI-powered
skill.summary: AI clothes changer — dress a person (image 1) in the garment shown in another photo (image 2)

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of ai-clothes-changer CLI skill.
- Dress a person in one image with the garment from a second image using AI.
- Requires weshop-cli and WESHOP_API_KEY environment variable.
- Command: weshop ai-clothes-changer --image <person> --image <garment>
- Outputs processed images with updated clothing.
- Enhanced documentation with security and setup instructions.
